# Heavy-tier CI shards: one `<shard> <package> <Test>` line per heavy test.
# ci.yml runs each shard as one `test-heavy (<shard>)` job; every shard id
# here must be in its `shard:` matrix, which also lists `catchall`. A heavy
# test this file does not name runs in the catchall shard, so a new heavy
# test is never skipped: add it here to balance the shards. Validate with
# `go run ./internal/tools/citest heavy-check`; list the current split with
# `heavy-list`. Balance (E5-S1): local wall of each shard run alone
# (`citest heavy-run <shard> -count=1 -json`, 10-core arm64, warm build
# cache); CI is ~3.3x that. A shard's wall is set by its slowest package,
# and the serial (heap-measuring) service tests run one at a time, so
# service's serial tests spread over shards 1-3 and the small packages
# share shard 5 rather than contend with service in shard 3.
